contract: the DVD subpicture cases whose FFmpeg result depends on the target, decoded and folded as subtitle-dvd decodes and folds them: cases the reference flags because they reach a C library result that differs between 32-bit ARM and AArch64 for the same arguments (harness/reference_subtitles_host.h)
each case is pinned per target from that target's own reference run, with the reference's flag; a case passes when the candidate, the reference and the target's pin agree
the decoder follows FFmpeg built with GCC for armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf; where FFmpeg for aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu gives another result, the case is open there as a deliberate divergence
preparation outside the timed operation: open the input, select the subpicture stream and its configuration, and copy its packets in demux order

one timed operation: create and open the decoder with the stream's configuration, packet time base and options (a decoder that refuses to open folds as no subtitles and the word 2^64 - 1 in both workers), decode every prepared packet with one call each, drain, fold every output subtitle and free it, free the decoder
pending_module_requirements: a deliberate divergence: FFmpeg built for aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu reads some numbers of a DVD option, configuration or VobSub index with 64 bits where FFmpeg built for 32-bit ARM reads them with 32, so there a palette number beyond 32 bits gives another colour, a size: number beyond int's range a canvas where 32-bit ARM refuses to open the decoder, and a delay: field beyond int's range another time; the decoder follows 32-bit ARM
